name: Lafayette, Louisiana
boundsNote: Padded planning envelope around the reviewed inventory. It is a configuration extent, not a legal boundary, a property boundary or a claim of immersive coverage.
inventoryBoundsNote: Derived from the 17 catalog coordinates in catalog version 1.0.0. Most coordinates are geocoded approximations that still need checking at the intended entrance.

primary.label: Louisiana DOTD, 2025 6-inch aerial
primary.formatNote: JPEG is requested because the equivalent PNG32 response is roughly nine times larger for the same tile. JPEG is opaque at coverage edges; jpgpng is the escape hatch if edge transparency becomes necessary.
primary.resolutionNote: One 512-pixel request replaces four 256-pixel requests, so maxZoom is 20 rather than 21 for the same ground resolution.

imagery.accuracyNote: Aerial imagery is scouting context. It is supplied as-is and is not authoritative for navigation, engineering, legal, property-transfer or other high-precision site-specific work, and it is not evidence of present physical condition.

excluded.reason: 2026 six-inch natural-colour imagery whose published extent and direct sample requests did not cover the Lafayette inventory. Sample requests returned no-data images. It must never be configured as the Lafayette primary source, and a successful HTTP response is not evidence of pixel coverage.

immersive.allowlistNote: Only these experiences may be loaded. The first is shared by six separate downtown location records, which remain distinct catalog entries.

optional3d.credentialNote: No credential is committed. When absent, unauthorised or slow, the aerial, imported-plan and blank-grid workspaces remain fully usable and authored objects are unaffected.

storage.isolationNote: This origin also serves neighbouring applications. Every key, database and cache name is SLiVR-scoped, and no code may enumerate or remove another application's service-worker registrations or caches.
